about.heroTitle: We are the Feast of Esther.
storyParagraphs: Feast of Esther is an annual divine assignment organized by Pastor (Mrs.) Folu Adeboye, wife of the General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God.
Since its inception in 2002, the gathering has expanded from Nigeria across Africa, Europe, and North America, strengthening women in ministry through worship, prayer, and fellowship.
about.missionTitle: For such a time as this.
about.missionIntro: Feast of Esther 2026 will be held June 18th–20th, 2026 at Dallas/Fort Worth Airport Marriott, 8440 Freeport Parkway, Irving, Texas, USA, 75063.
about.missionBody: A forum where women in ministry learn to accomplish their calling, stand in the gap, and impact the church for revival in the nation.

leadershipProfiles.name: Pastor Anthonia Adeyeye
leadershipProfiles.role: Chairperson (President) · Country Coordinator Feast of Esther USA · Continental Evangelist RCCG America
leadershipProfiles.blurb:
Pastor Anthonia Adeyeye is a dynamic evangelist and Deliverance Minister; she and her husband are gifted marriage counselors, serving the Lord from her youthful days.

She pioneered churches in Nigeria and the UK, took RCCG to Ireland, and established RCCG in Sacramento, Oakland, and Stockton, California. She co-pastors the Pavilion of Redemption in Sugar Land, Texas.

chairperson.name: Pastor Anthonia Adeyeye
chairperson.title: Chairperson (President)
chairperson.subtitle: Country Coordinator · Feast of Esther USA
responsibilities: Provides overall leadership and direction.
Presides over board meetings and ensures productive discussions.
Facilitates decision-making and ensures board resolutions are implemented.
Represents the organization at official events, partnerships, and engagements.
Makes key decisions and oversees strategy.
bioParagraphs: Pastor Anthonia Adeyeye is a dynamic evangelist and Deliverance Minister. She and her husband are gifted marriage counselors who have served the Lord faithfully over many years.
She was used by God to pioneer churches in Nigeria and the UK, and was instrumental in taking RCCG to the Republic of Ireland. She started the first RCCG Yoruba/English Church in London.
The Lord established RCCG expressions in Sacramento, Oakland, and Stockton through Pastor Anthonia and her husband. They currently co-pastor in Sugar Land, Texas.

Her ministry has impacted many nations through healing, deliverance, and revival. She was promoted as the first female regional evangelist in RCCG and later as the first female continental evangelist in RCCG America.

committee.title: Marketing & Social Media Coordinator
committee.subtitle: Assisted by Pastor Temitosan Abimbola

about.heroTitle: We are the Feast of Esther.
storyParagraphs: Feast of Esther is an annual divine assignment organized by Pastor (Mrs.) Folu Adeboye, wife of the General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God.
Since its inception in 2002, the gathering has expanded from Nigeria across Africa, Europe, and North America, strengthening women in ministry through worship, prayer, and fellowship.
about.missionTitle: For such a time as this.
about.missionIntro: Feast of Esther 2026 will be held June 18th–20th, 2026 at Dallas/Fort Worth Airport Marriott, 8440 Freeport Parkway, Irving, Texas, USA, 75063.
about.missionBody: A forum where women in ministry learn to accomplish their calling, stand in the gap, and impact the church for revival in the nation.

leadershipProfiles.name: Pastor Mrs. Grace Okonrende
leadershipProfiles.role: Country Coordinator Feast of Esther USA · Continental Evangelist RCCG America
leadershipProfiles.blurb:
Pastor Grace Okonrende is a dynamic evangelist and Deliverance Minister; she and her husband are gifted marriage counselors, serving the Lord from her youthful days.

She pioneered churches in Nigeria and the UK, took RCCG to Ireland, and established RCCG in Sacramento, Oakland, and Stockton, California. She co-pastors the Pavilion of Redemption in Sugar Land, Texas.
